title: THE ULTIMATE CHINESE GRAVEL FRAMESET CARBONDA 696?
disclosure: The creator bought the frameset and itemises what he paid; the description links Carbonda's product page and a builds forum thread.
summary: Unboxing and weigh-in before the owner's build: about US$727 delivered with axles, spare hangers and express shipping, a size 56 frame at about 1,225 g without bolts and a 546 g fork, plus the ordering process.
